note: A DATA line with no LF is buffered whole (src/smtp/session.rs read_until without take), so a 300 MiB no-LF line grows anon well past the bound before MAX_DATA_LINE is checked. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/finding_f1_data_line.rs.
simmer_unmatched_sender_total{domain} is client-controlled. Capping it diverges from SPEC.md §9.1 and needs the spec author. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/metrics_endpoint.rs.
Outbound AUTH is always PLAIN (src/downstream/client.rs): a downstream offering only LOGIN answers 535 and Simmer defers 451 on every retry. Observed against postfix-login-only in the T2 matrix.

timeouts.session runs from connect, so it cancels an in-flight relay: the downstream has already stored the message but Simmer neither counts it as ambiguous nor tells the client. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/findings.rs.
The same cancellation leaks the reservation: reservations_in_flight, the quota_reservation rows and quota_usage.reserved all stay non-zero after the load, until the sweeper expires them.

No lock_timeout or statement_timeout (src/db.rs sets only acquire_timeout), so a query that already holds a pool connection waits on a blocked row or table indefinitely: measured at ~27 s to answer while a lock was held for 25 s.
